subject: Finovate AWS private offer: approval routing and term alignment
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Finovate private offer — procurement asks + next steps

Quick recap from this morning's discovery with Finovate (Samir + procurement):

- Finovate is evaluating a production pilot for our hosted inference flows (private dataset).
- They requested a private offer in AWS Marketplace; procurement prefers 24 months but buyer stakeholders are sensitive to long-term lock.
- Pricing ask: want a stepped discount tied to committed spend (baseline + ramp).
- They need evidence for SOC2 and a contract path mapped to their procurement lanes (finance + legal sign-off).

Attachments: Finovate_requirements.pdf, pricing_model_v1.xlsx (first-pass numbers).

Ask: can you two map the quickest internal approval lane and whether we can present both 12- and 24-month options with clear activation/termination dates? Also flag any AWS Marketplace gating that will slow private-offer activation — I want to set correct expectations with Samir.

Thanks,
Neha

Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finovate private offer — procurement asks + next steps

Thanks for the summary, Neha. Quick notes after reviewing the requirements: 

1) Approval lanes (high level):
   - Procurement sign-off -> Finance (pricing/proration) -> Legal (T&Cs) -> Marketplace ops for private-offer creation.
   - If finance needs to split billing across BU, activation can be delayed while marketplace team validates buyer IDs.

2) Term / Pricing options to present (recommended):
   - Option A: 12 months, modest 8% discount, lower commitment thresholds, faster activation window (2-3 weeks).
   - Option B: 24 months, 15% discount with a 6-month ramp and early-termination with prorated refund schedule.
   - Option C (compromise): 18 months, 12% discount, capped true-up at 12 months.

3) AWS Marketplace gating: Private-offer creation itself is straightforward if we have the buyer Entitlement ID and sponsor AWS account. The typical slow points are: signed PO + billing contact verification + legal countersign (if they request non-standard clauses). If procurement wants to route through centralized finance, expect 2–4 week delay.

I've attached a quick approval_matrix.csv that maps approver roles and the expected response SLAs.

If you want, I can draft the two-term slides for Samir before you send.

-Jonas

Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@finovate.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 01 Jul 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Finovate private offer — procurement asks + next steps

Hi Samir — following up with our internal options and next steps. 

Per our call, here are two options we'd like your feedback on (we can iterate):

- 12-month pilot: 8% discount, immediate activation target (once PO is signed) — lower commitment, faster time-to-value.
- 24-month commit: 15% discount, 6-month ramp; better unit economics for you but longer lock-in.

We can also propose an 18-month compromise (12% discount) if procurement needs a middle ground. Important notes: private-offer activation requires buyer Entitlement ID and procurement-signed PO. If finance needs additional evidence (SOC2 docs, contract redlines), that will add to the timeline.

Attachments: Finovate_requirements.pdf, pricing_model_v1.xlsx

Can you confirm: 1) which term you prefer, and 2) whether your procurement requires direct AWS invoicing or a third-party billing arrangement? Once we have that, we'll route to Marketplace Ops and legal and aim to have a private offer draft within 5 business days (assuming no unusual redlines).

Best,
Neha

Neha Kapoor

From: Samir Shah <samir@finovate.com>

Date: Mon, 02 Jul 2028 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Finovate private offer — procurement asks + next steps

Neha — thanks for sending these options. Procurement rationale:

- Our finance team prefers 24 months to match budget cycles and secure the best unit price.
- Procurement will only sign once finance signs off on the proration schedule and termination clauses.
- We do require SOC2 evidence and a short security questionnaire answered before legal will escalate.

Question for Redwood: does the 24-month option include co-sell eligibility (we have a strategic ISV program and want to ensure joint GTM is available)? Also please confirm whether AWS Marketplace invoicing can be direct to us, or if Redwood needs to own billing.

I can push procurement to expedite if we can lock a clear termination/proration clause and provide SOC2 now.

—Samir
Samir Shah
Director, Procurement | Finovate
samir@finovate.com | +1 (212) 555-0911
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@finovate.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finovate private offer — approval routing and term alignment

Samir / team — really appreciate the clarity. Quick proposal to move the deal forward without blocking revenue: 

- Offer: 18-month term, 12% discount, structured ramp with a 6-month true-up. Early termination allowed with 90-day notice and prorated refund (per schedule).
- Co-sell: yes — we will include standard co-sell entitlements in the private-offer addendum and loop Jonas' partnerships team to coordinate launch.
- Billing: we can support direct AWS Marketplace invoicing to Finovate (recommended) — will need buyer Entitlement ID and billing contact to complete setup.

Neha: please start legal with term_sheet_v2.pdf attached. Lauren — can you prioritize finance review for the proration schedule? Jonas — coordinate co-sell playbook and channel enablement.

If AWS Marketplace Ops (cc'd) can confirm expected private-offer activation timeline once buyer Entitlement ID and signed PO are submitted, we can set a target activation date.

I'll keep this thread as the single source of truth — if everyone agrees, Neha can send the updated term sheet and we'll start the signature path.

Thanks,
Vivek
